verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that BILL has a v3 API, and an error message references a Spend & Expense apiToken. Nothing in the pack documents issuing scoped, permission-limited or least-privilege API credentials. SSO, dual control and sandbox credentials are related controls, not scoped agent credentials, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
